speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your bleeding issues, can you tell me how long the bleeding from your wisdom tooth extraction has persisted, and have you noticed any other unusual bleeding or bruising episodes in the past?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the bleeding from your gums stop if you apply firm, direct pressure for a prolonged period, or does it continue despite pressure? Additionally, have you ever experienced bleeding into your joints or deep muscles?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your family history of joint swelling and easy bruising, have you personally ever experienced painful swelling in your knees, elbows, or ankles after minor injuries?
